description: A Fabric mod for Minecraft 26.3. Mobs evolve from how you kill them. Each mob carries genes and a family. You pick perks with a trade-off, and track each species in your Beagle Notebook.

mods.name: On the Origin of Spawns
mods.description: Mobs evolve from how you kill them. You pick adaptations with a trade-off. Track each species in your Beagle Notebook.

releases.notes:
The skeletons evolve. The skeleton, the stray, the bogged, the wither skeleton, and the parched each have 30 genes, 5 families, 20 minor families, and 10 hybrids of their own. They share no genes with each other or with the zombies.

This is an alpha. Expect balance changes, and use a test world. The [wiki](https://stiven-gjekaj.github.io/OnTheOriginOfSpawns/) shows each gene and family, with pictures from the game.

> **Content warning: body horror.** Some gene mixes show bare bone, cracks, rot, fungus, and blood.

## The skeleton
- **Marksmen** shoot hard and far. Close up, they are easy to hit.
- **Rattlers** are fast and hard to catch. Backpedal keeps 12 blocks from you.
- **Ossified** skeletons have thick, heavy bones. They are slow.
- **Legions** fight in ranks. Barrage lines up the shots of the group at you. Alone, they are weak.
- **Hexers** shoot cursed arrows. The sun burns their dark bones faster.

## The stray
- **Glaciers** grow a shell of ice. Fire melts it.
- **Blizzards** are strong in a snowstorm and weak under a clear sky.
- **Drifters** wander over the snow and walk on powder snow. Away from snow and ice, they are slow.
- **Frostbiters** shoot arrows that freeze. Their arrows are brittle.
- **Wailers** are the pale, lost dead of the snow. Ghostshot arrows are hidden past 4 blocks.

## The bogged
- **Sporecaps** grow thick fungus. The fungus burns easily. Shear the mushrooms, and Regrowth grows them back.
- **Mirefolk** are at home in water and mud. Mudburrow rises out of the mud. On dry ground, they are slow.
- **Venomers** shoot stronger poison. Their arrows are weaker.
- **Vinebound** bogged are wrapped in vines that hold you.
- **Mosshides** hide in the plants of the swamp. Their bodies are soft.

## The wither skeleton
- **Blademasters** are masters of the sword. Parry blocks a whole hit, and Cleave also hits the players next to its target. They do not guard against arrows.
- **Ashborn** carry the fire of the Nether. Snowballs, splash water, and freezing hurt them.
- **Witherlords** carry a stronger curse. Skull Shot shoots the black skull of the Wither. The curse makes them slow.
- **Ramparts** guard the fortress. Brickplate and Brickshield make them hard to hurt. Smite Ward resists Smite.
- **Soul Reapers** feed on souls. Their bodies are thin.

## The parched
- **Enfeeblers** carry a stronger curse of weakness. Fumble can make you drop the item in your hand.
- **Windcarvers** shoot on the desert wind. Whirlwind Volley shoots three arrows in a fan.
- **Vultures** hunt the weak and the wounded. A healthy target is hard for them.
- **Scorpions** have a poison sting. Sand Hide is almost invisible on sand in the day. The heat of the day makes them slow.
- **Fossils** are bones that turned to stone. Stone breaks in a blast.

## Equipment
- Skeletons with genes keep their natural weapon: the bow, or the stone sword of the wither skeleton. They get no random armor and do not pick up items.
- Spider jockeys come only from a gene, not at random.

## New causes of death
- `wolf`, `shield`, `snow`, `warm`, `dry`, `shears`, `smite`, and `day` now change the gene pools.

## Fixes
- The husk and the drowned now show their gene marks in the game.
- An arrow that a shield blocks gives no hit effects.
- Each effect that a mob gives when it is hurt now has its own cooldown.

## Data packs
- New effect types for arrows, freezing, auras, parries, skulls, and souls, and new states such as `on_snow`, `night`, `in_lava`, `day`, and `target_weakened`.
- The [data pack guide](https://github.com/Stiven-Gjekaj/OnTheOriginOfSpawns/blob/main/docs/data-packs.md) describes each field.

## Upgrade
- Zombies, husks, and drowned from 0.3.1-alpha keep their genes. Skeletons, strays, bogged, wither skeletons, and parched get genes when they next load.
- The families that you found in the Beagle Notebook stay found.

## Requirements
- Minecraft 26.3
- Fabric Loader 0.19.5 or later
- Fabric API

releases.notes:
The husk and the drowned evolve. Each one has 30 genes, 5 families, 20 minor families, and 10 hybrids of its own. They share no genes with the zombie.

This is an alpha. Expect balance changes, and use a test world. The [wiki](https://stiven-gjekaj.github.io/OnTheOriginOfSpawns/) shows each gene and family.

> **Content warning: body horror.** Some gene mixes show bare bone, open wounds, stitched gashes, blood, rot, fungus, and veins on the skin.

## The husk
- **Scorchers** are strong in the sun and weak in the dark. Sunbaked heals in sunlight. Heatshimmer makes projectiles miss and go through it. Solar Flare blinds players when it dies in daylight.
- **Dunecrawlers** live in the sand. Sandswimmer rises out of the sand next to you. Scuttler climbs walls, but not glass. Duststorm gives Darkness to players near it.
- **Mummies** are hard to kill. Undying survives one lethal hit with a burst of sand. Wrapped resists projectiles and melee. Cursetouch gives Weakness. Embalmed ignores Poison, Wither, and Hunger. Tomb Guard cannot be knocked back. Grave Dust leaves a cloud of Slowness when it dies.
- **Caravans** travel in groups. Linked takes less damage near other husks. Signal Fire sends up smoke and calls the husks near it. Nomad leads a line of husks. Sandling spawns as a baby husk.
- **Parchers** take your water and your food. Thirstbite and Dehydrator drain your hunger. Mirage Water shows a false pool of water and is hard to see. Desiccate gives Hunger to players near it. Salt Crust stops a husk from turning into a zombie in water.

## The drowned
- **Riptides** are fast in water. Surge dashes at you through the water. Breacher jumps out of the water at you on the shore, on a dock, or in a boat. Undertow pulls you down. Capsizer breaks your boat.
- **Harpooners** throw tridents. Volley throws two times as often. Barbed tridents give Slowness. Spearfisher throws farther at players in water or in boats. Scavenger picks up the tridents that you throw. Stormcaller calls lightning with its trident in a storm.
- **Abyssals** come from the dark and the deep. Lure hangs a light that goes out when you come near, and its first hit does double damage. Pressure Hide is tough in the deep. Blind Hunter finds invisible players, but not a player who sneaks. Ink blinds you when you hit it.
- **Barnacled** grow shells. Coral Growth hurts you when you hit it. Shellback takes less damage from behind. Anchor sinks fast. Pearlheart heals to full one time. Kelpwrapped is almost invisible in kelp.
- **Sirens** sing. The family pulls players in water toward it. Siren Song slows swimmers. Drag Under holds you and sinks with you. Chorus calls the drowned near it. Fry spawns as a baby drowned.

## Equipment
- Mobs with genes no longer spawn with random weapons or random armor, and they do not pick up items.
- Natural weapons stay: the trident and the fishing rod of the drowned, and the iron spear of a husk that rides a camel husk.
- Genes can give items: Tridentborn and the Harpooners give tridents, and Packmule picks up items.

## Babies and conversion
- Baby husks come only from Sandling, and baby drowned come only from Fry.
- A mob that converts to a different species, for example a zombie that drowns, gets new genes from the pool of the new species. It keeps none of its old genes.

## Living evolution
- A mob that lives for one Minecraft day or more can swap its weakest gene for a gene that its pool now favors. This happens only where no player is near and no player can see it.
- A mob with a name tag never changes its genes.

## Knowledge
- You see the family of a mob after you watch it for 8 seconds in 16 blocks.
- You learn the genes of a mob when you kill it, or when it kills you.
- The mob info panel and the Beagle Notebook show only what you know.

## Fixes
- Burrowing zombies now rise to the surface and stop for 2 seconds, as the design says.

releases.notes:
The complete zombie. Zombies now have 30 genes, 5 families, 20 minor families, and 10 hybrids.

This is an alpha. Expect balance changes, and use a test world. The [wiki](https://stiven-gjekaj.github.io/OnTheOriginOfSpawns/) shows each gene and family.

> **Content warning: body horror.** Some gene mixes show bare bone, open wounds, blood, rot, fungus, and veins on the skin.

## Families
- Each gene has a family tag. The tags of the genes of a zombie decide its family.
- The 5 families are Predators, Stalkers, Tanks, Hordes, and Blights. Each family has a buff and a debuff at 3 tiers.
- A pure family gives tier 3. A hybrid gives tier 2 of both families. A minor family gives tier 2 of its major family and tier 1 of its sub family. A zombie with too few points stays neutral.
- The 20 minor families and the 10 hybrids each have a name, for example Ambushers, Juggernauts, Gloamhunters, and Plaguetide.

## 27 new genes
- **Predators:** Lunger leaps at you. Frenzy attacks faster. Bloodscent finds invisible and hurt players. Rabid gives Nausea and sometimes attacks other mobs. Death Throes hurts players near it when it dies, and has a glowing fuse.
- **Stalkers:** Hush makes no idle or hurt sounds. Shade is almost invisible at night. Burrower rises out of the ground near you at night. Lurker does not move while you look at it. Nightborn is faster and stronger in the dark.
- **Tanks:** Thickskull takes no extra damage from critical hits. Bloat has more health and leaves Poison when it dies. Stoneblood takes no fall damage. Blastproof resists explosions. Mender heals out of combat.
- **Hordes:** Packcaller calls the zombies near it when it sees you. Brood spawns in bigger groups. Rally hits harder near other zombies. Runt spawns as a baby. Grave Call can call a new zombie when you hit it. Siege breaks doors and glass.
- **Blights:** Rotgut gives Hunger II. Contagion turns each villager it kills into a zombie villager, and iron golems attack it first. Sporebearer leaves a cloud of Weakness when it dies. Leech takes your XP. Miasma gives Weakness to players near it and glows. Plague Carrier raises a player that it kills as a zombie.
- Each gene has a downside, and each gene changes how the zombie looks.

## New causes of death
- Sunlight, a player that sees the zombie from far away, a zombie alone, a crowd of deaths, critical hits, iron golems, and a zombie that kills a player. Each one makes a gene stronger.

## Baby zombies
- Baby zombies come only from the Runt gene. Thus, a baby zombie shows that its pool evolved Runt.
- Gene marks and gene models fit baby zombies.

## Mob info panel
- Look at a mob with genes to see its family and its genes. The genes of its family show first.
- The panel of a see-through Shade shows only up close.

## Beagle Notebook
- The notebook has a tab for each species, with a page of genes and a page of families.
- You find a family when you come within 16 blocks of a zombie of that family. A family that you did not find shows as "???".

## Data packs
- New registry: `family`. New effect types for combat, behavior, sounds, auras, and clouds on death.
- Gene visuals can set an `order` for their layers. Gene model parts can turn, glow, and use the texture of the mob.
- The [data pack guide](https://github.com/Stiven-Gjekaj/OnTheOriginOfSpawns/blob/main/docs/data-packs.md) describes each field.

## Upgrade
- Zombies from 0.1.0-alpha keep their genes. Their family is neutral until new zombies spawn.

## Requirements
- Minecraft 26.3
- Fabric Loader 0.19.5 or later
- Fabric API

releases.notes:
The first alpha of On the Origin of Spawns. Zombies evolve from how you kill them.

This is an alpha. It has the core loop for zombies only. Expect balance changes, and use a test world.

## Evolution
- Zombies have a gene pool for each biome category: hot, cold, wet, temperate, nether, and end.
- Each zombie death counts for its cause. The gene that counters the cause becomes more common in the pool of that biome category.
- Each new zombie gets up to 5 genes from its pool. Two zombies from the same pool can be different.
- Genes fade slowly when their cause stops.

## Genes
- Cinder: immune to fire, and can set you on fire. Rain and water hurt it, and it has less health. Its skin turns gray, with burnt hands and feet.
- Ironhide: takes half damage from projectiles, and resists knockback. It is slower, and takes more damage from explosions. It wears iron plates on its shirt and sleeves.
- Bonerunner: faster, and chases you from farther away. It has less armor, and takes more fall damage. Its lower legs are bare bone.

How to get them: burn zombies for Cinder, shoot them for Ironhide, and kill them before they hit you for Bonerunner.

## Beagle Notebook
- Craft it from a book, leather, and string.
- Use it to see the gene frequencies of zombies in each biome category.

## Commands
- `/originofspawns pool get <species> <category>` and `/originofspawns pool set <species> <category> <gene> <frequency>` show and change a pool. They need operator permission.

## Requirements
- Minecraft 26.3
- Fabric Loader 0.19.5 or later
- Fabric API
